usedFor: GenPage manages web pages, and “Create or Update Lead” sends it a person from another app.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal” in Kylas CRM, then “Create or Update Lead” in GenPage
bestTemplate.why: A new deal is a lead worth following, and the action creates or updates it in GenPage.

watchOut: “Create or Update Lead” can change an existing lead, so test with one record to see what it matches.
